name: dynamic-ticket-pricing
description: Dynamic Ticket Pricing System with ML-powered price predictions

scripts.build-and-package: npm run build && npm run package && npm run clean-build
scripts.clean-build: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Path '.\dist\*.blockmap' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path '.\dist\latest.yml' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path '.\dist\builder-*.yaml' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path '.\dist\builder-debug.yml' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item -Path '.\dist\win-unpacked' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'Build cleaned - only .exe and web assets remaining'"
